The '''Republic Security and Deep Space Monitory Act''' was a law passed by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Section 12a of the act granted Republic agents "observational authority" over various regions; [[Tythan Phomm]] held observational authority over the [[Nikto Sector]], a district of the neutral [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].
